subject: NGINX proxy over shiny-server: broken IE 8 compatibility

messages.author: 1e1f6c27d3c442a5
messages.subject: NGINX proxy over shiny-server: broken IE 8 compatibility
parts:
I wanted to use a nginx proxy for ssl & password protection features, that are currently not available in shiny-server.
But it seems that default nginx config has broken IE 8 and  9 compatibility with shiny-server.

If anyone has any idea of the fixes to put in nginx config to keep shiny-server working with IE 8, I am quite interested...

messages.author: df48d74a0d970c93
messages.subject: Re: NGINX proxy over shiny-server: broken IE 8 compatibility
parts:
at least the below setting works great in nginx and IE8, but there is no password production or SSL.
server {
  listen       80;
  server_name  shinyapp;
  location / {
    proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3838;
    proxy_redirect http://127.0.0.1:3838/ $scheme://$host/;

}
}
